blocks.label: Warnings
paragraphs: Keep out of reach of children and pets. Consult with a qualified healthcare professional prior to using this product, especially if you are pregnant, nursing, have a diagnosed medical condition, are taking a prescription medication (e.g ., blood thinners), or are planning a surgical procedure. Do not exceed recommended daily intake. Do not use if safety seal is damaged or missing. Store at room temperature, in a dry place. Protect product from excessive heat, freezing, humidity and light.
